description: Persistent headless LLM chat sessions with a pinned model, stored at data/chat/sessions/<name>.json. The chat app minus the interface: create a named session pinned to a gateway model, inject context (messages or storage files), send messages (the session's model can call workshop tools via a single dispatcher, including other chat sessions — recursion bounded by a run-chain cycle guard), inspect/update/compact/delete. CALL SHAPE: {"method":"chat.<action>","payload":{...}}.

tools.name: chat_create
tools.description: Create a new chat session. Throws if the name already exists (no silent reuse). Model must be a known gateway chat model ID (validated against listModels('chat') — typos fail immediately). Name charset: [a-z0-9][a-z0-9._-]*.

name.description: Session name — the ID, human-addressable, used as filename

model.description: Gateway chat model ID to pin (e.g. deepseek-flash-chat, kimi-k3-chat)

systemPrompt.description: Optional system prompt for the session

tools.name: chat_send
tools.description: Send a user message to a session and run its tool loop to completion. Returns { reply, toolCalls, hops, usage, messageCount, historyBytes }. The session's model sees ONE dispatcher tool ('workshop') giving it the full workshop tool catalog. Optional per-send model override (does NOT re-pin the session — use chat.update for that). Cyclic sends (target already upstream in the call chain) fail as tool-result errors, never queue.

tools.name: chat_inject
tools.description: Append context WITHOUT calling the model — the twin-ingest primitive. messages: array of {role:'user'|'assistant', content} appended verbatim. files: array of storage paths, each read via the storage agent (inherits sandbox, UNC translation, maxReadSize) and appended as one user message '=== storage:<path> ===\n<content>'. At least one of messages/files required.

files.description: Storage paths to read and append as user messages

tools.name: chat_list
tools.description: List all chat sessions: name, model, messageCount, historyBytes, createdAt, updatedAt.

tools.name: chat_history
tools.description: Return a session's stored messages in chronological order, full fidelity by default. lastN trims to the last N messages for large sessions.

lastN.description: Return only the last N messages

tools.name: chat_update
tools.description: Mid-life re-pin of a session: change systemPrompt and/or model. At least one field required. Model change validated like create.

model.description: New gateway chat model ID to pin

tools.name: chat_compact
tools.description: Caller-invoked compaction (never automatic). Strategies: 'clear' — wipe messages (systemPrompt survives; keep=N preserves last N, default 0); 'truncate' — keep last keep* messages; 'summarize' — messages [0..upTo) replaced by ONE summary generated by the session's model (override via model arg) with a fixed extractive prompt; history rewritten only after the summary text exists.

keep.description: clear: last N messages to preserve (default 0); truncate: required, last N to keep

upTo.description: summarize: replace messages [0..upTo) with the summary

model.description: summarize: model override for the summary call

tools.name: chat_delete
tools.description: Delete a session file. Irreversible; no recycle bin.
